proposed.title: DeepInfer: DeepSeek's open-source production inference framework for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (draft-token decoding with confidence-scheduled verification, async batch scheduler, batch-invariant/deterministic sampling, structured outputs); Apache-2.0, needs NVIDIA SM100 or Ascend 950

built.title: equity-research-skill: open-source agent skill for institutional-style single-stock reports (nine chapters, expectations gap, earnings-quality grade, scripted DCF/EPV/EVA in scripts/dcf.py, missing data written as not obtained); US, HK, A-shares

WorldMonitor signal-to-trade desk: six role agents (scan, price vs prediction markets, sentiment, trade, settle, supervise) on top of open-source WorldMonitor; angle is paper trading plus a fast loser-cut exit rule
magpie: one local gateway that puts any model behind any coding agent (Claude Code on Kimi, Codex on DeepSeek) with routing groups that fail over between accounts when a quota runs out
Yobiru: open-source agent-to-agent relay over your own Tailscale network (address by machine/agent, text/JSON/files with SHA-256 check, replies route back, per-machine wake permissions)
Claude Code dynamic workflows: Claude writes its own JS harness on the fly (spawn subagents, pick models, worktrees, adversarial checks)
HarnessRouter: Unified Harness Protocol. Run Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, Pi under one Responses-compatible API
OpenDots: CopilotKit's self-hostable always-on AI coworkers (per-Dot roles, permissions, own computer, any AG-UI harness)
pstack /correct: find recurring agent mistakes and fix the environment (architecture, types, checks)
Pi SDK + Jev — custom agent harness (model pick, tool gate, answer check)
Claude Code Mods: TypeScript in-process hooks to change Claude Code behavior and UI
Hermes Agent — Nous Research self-improving agent harness (skills + memory loop)
Claude Agent Loops — turn/goal/time/proactive loop patterns
Codex Security CLI — OpenAI open-source security scan/fix SDK
AgentRun — workflow DSL/harness for repetitive agent work (powered by Jev)
Archify — agent skill for verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
Jev (TypeSafe System One) — decision-layer AI model
Claude Commerce Agents — open-source shopping/merchant agent blueprint
